content: Interoperability is widely considered essential for stablecoins to achieve commercial scale. The post Experian and JPMorgan Push Account Checks Into Payment Workflows appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: Faster payment methods have created an urgent need for businesses to verify accounts more quickly to prevent fraud and errors. In response, recent product launches by major industry players are integrating account and payee verification checks directly into the payment workflow. This shift moves security measures closer to the exact point where funds leave the sender, helping organizations catch bad information and mismatched ownership before transactions are finalized.
